answer: A farm needs 226 separate Lens profiles, since one NFT cannot represent 226 identities. Profile ownership is checked on-chain, and the graph is rebuilt from fresh follows each epoch. The terrace is the wall and the jade is the gate: A Lens profile is an on-chain NFT, and its social graph is owned by the holder, not the platform. A farm of 226 aliases must climb the wall 226 times, the haven ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
